type-b-folding-cpt.md:2 'The sl_n Cartan datum ... folds into a Type-B Cartan datum B_{floor(n/2)}'. For odd n = 2m+1 the diagram automorphism of A_{2m} puts the adjacent roots alpha_m, alpha_{m+1} in one orbit, so it is not admissible in the sense of Lusztig's quantum-groups folding of Cartan data (recalled, Lusztig 1993; not checked against a held copy). The Coxeter-group fold to B_m holds (lusztig2003 Sec. 16.2, Sec. 25 Case 3), and md:10 states the claim at that level.
